additional_info.subject: RE: 0397075 - ID0397075-DC/Si-D/PL- [MP / P9 170000982] Charger is changing its states. CRM:02023000387
additional_info.body:
Dear Konrad,
I hope this message finds you well.
Please see below the reasons for the charger status being reported as faulted.
Sr No
Timestamp in UTC
Reason
1
2024-12-13, 08:26:23
Internal communication error in power converter
2
2024-12-13, 00:25:45
Internal communication error in power converter
3
2024-12-13, 12:41:14
The remote start was initiated on 2024-12-13 at 12:37:02, but the cable was not connected to outlet 2 until 2024-12-13 at 12:39:22, resulting in a failed session with a V2G timeout error
4
2024-12-13, 13:15:53
emergency stop button was pressed for approx. 1 min, so status becomes faulted during that period
Query
-
When the cable is disconnected, the station reports first the FAULTED status and then the AVAILABLE status.
Answer
- When the cable is disconnected from the charger, the station first shows a "FAULTED" status, meaning there was an unexpected disconnection or a connection issue. After that, it changes to "AVAILABLE," signaling that the charger is ready for the next vehicle. This ensures any issues are resolved before the charger is ready to use again.
We have addressed your queries. Please let me know if we can proceed with closing the case.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: 0397075 - ID0397075-DC/Si-D/PL- [MP / P9 170000982] Charger is changing its states. CRM:02023000387
additional_info.body:
Dear Vikas,
Thank you for answer about faulted, there is one more case to explain:
Abnormal statuses during server response delays (CRITICAL)
During tests with server response delays, the station repeatedly changed statuses to UNAVAILABLE and then to AVAILABLE, which can cause communication and operational stability problems.
To fully explain the situation, they were testing. They tested how the charger would behave when it did not receive a response from the backend server, so they increased the response time of the server to the maximum and, according to them, the charger in this situation started to change its status from available to unavailable and back again several times after a while. Then it looks like it flashes alternately sending this status. This happened between 12 and 14 UTC during these tests, unfortunately I cannot find this situation directly in their logs they sent us.
BR
Konrad

This is true, we know it. We are discussing with ECOG if this can be fixed.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0397075 - ID0397075-DC/Si-D/PL- [MP / P9 170000982] Charger is changing its states. CRM:02023000387
additional_info.body:
Hello Konrad,
I hope you're doing well.
Based on the logs, we observed that the command
OCPP: Received command: GetConfiguration (conf6771701b766709_69999349) - {"key":["PowerSavingModeSchedule"]},
was executed, which has caused the charger to enter Power Saving Mode.
When this mode is activated and no charging processes are active, the main switch (QA1) opens after sometimes, disconnecting the power line (including the converters) from the mains. This may cause of the converter error you’ve been experiencing.
To resolve this issue, we are currently analyzing with expert support and will get back to you shortly with further details.
Thank you for your attention to this matter. We look forward to your response.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support

additional_info.subject: Handover from ES to NOC
additional_info.body:
Problem Description
:  When charger is in PSM and receives a RemoteStartTransaction, an “unavailable” status is sent to the Backend, making the charging session to abort.
Suspected Root Cause
:  Long time to allocate Power convertrs after PSM results in unavailable when the OCPP backend checks for status
Action Performed (ES)
:  Logs analysis performed, R&D ticket created and followed up. Hotfix is ready for v6.0.3 (Hotfix TIA v4.0.22). This Hotfix will be included in v6.1.3
Applied Hotfix on chargers
zc56tv, v3HnBw,
k7iriT,
PWnLON  and
AU4zn6
Charger SW Version
:  v6.0.3
Reason for Handover (ES/NOC
):  Hotfix installed, verified that issue is solved. Please close the ticket.
